notes:
SCOPE AND HEADLINE. 65 curated measurement rows across 18 oligo_ids and 17 source documents resolve to 19 human evidence units: 12 registered trials with a registry identifier verified by fetching the record (11 ClinicalTrials.gov NCTs via the API plus 1 EudraCT via the EU Clinical Trials Register), 
The 12 verified trial registry ids are NCT06058390, NCT03101878, NCT03714776, NCT04083222, NCT04449029, NCT01918865, NCT03582462, NCT03394144, NCT03728634, NCT00432770, NCT01350960 and EudraCT 2008-008532-82. 4 unregistered trials where absence of registration was positively established, 1 phase 1 healthy-volunteer study whose registration status could not be resolved either way, 1 observational cohort (unregistered), and 1 pooled analysis (which carries a PROSPERO systematic-review registration, CRD42023345231, that is deliberately NOT counted as a trial registration). Exactly 1 of the 19 is a pooled analysis and is typed as such. 63 of 65 rows are assigned; 2 are unassignable. Row-to-study ratio 3.3:1, driven almost entirely by three sources: the Vermeer 2026 meta-analysis (10 rows, 1 pooled unit), the eplontersen phase 1 (10 rows, 1 trial) and the bepirovirsen device study (5 rows, 1 trial).

TYPING CONVENTION, stated so it can be audited. registered_trial = an interventional study whose registry record this lane fetched and confirmed to match on compound, phase, population and design. unregistered_trial = an interventional study for which absence of registration was positively established (conduct dates predating ClinicalTrials.gov/ICMJE/FDAAA, plus an exhaustive compound-name registry search returning no matching record, plus no registration statement in the publication). healthy_volunteer_study is used for the one trial (bepirovirsen-ISIS505358-CS1) where the publication CLAIMS a registration but the cited NCT describes a different compound, so neither 'registered' nor 'unregistered' can honestly be asserted. pooled_analysis, observational_cohort etc. follow the brief. No record carries an invented identifier; every unknown is the literal string TBD.

REVIEWS, PATENTS AND SECONDARY TABLES WERE NOT COUNTED AS TRIALS. Four of the 17 source documents are not primary clinical reports: the Frazier 2015 review (doi:10.1177/0192623314551840), the US 2021/0355497 A1 patent, the Valenzuela 2023 minipig paper's literature-summary Table 2 (PMC10143489), and the Flierl 2015 mechanistic paper (PMC4322051). In each case the DOCUMENT was discarded as an evidence unit and an attempt was made to resolve the underlying trial from primary sources. Two succeeded and became study records with independently verified primaries: the Frazier review's dose-limiting-thrombocytopenia claim resolved to the Yuen 1999 ISIS 3521 phase 1 trial (PMID 10589745, verified), and the Valenzuela Table 2 RTR5001 cell resolved via its reference 37 to the SPC5001 first-in-human trial (NCT01350960 / EudraCT 2011-000489-36, verified). Two failed and were left unassignable rather than guessed (TMSR1558, TMSR981).

DEFECTS FOUND IN THE UNDERLYING SOURCES - these are the substantive findings of this pass.
(1) WRONG REGISTRY IDENTIFIER. Han K et al. 2022 (PMC9804925) cites 'ISIS 50538-CS1, NCT03020745' for the bepirovirsen first-in-human study. NCT03020745 was fetched and is '...Single Ascending Dose and Multiple Doses of GSK3389404 in Chronic Hepatitis B Subjects' (GSK 205670, PHASE2, 78 ACTUAL, healthyVolunteers false) - a different compound and a patient, not healthy-volunteer, population. Per the verify-or-do-not-assert rule the NCT is not asserted. The sponsor protocol number is also misprinted (bepirovirsen is ISIS 505358, not ISIS 50538).
(2) WRONG DENOMINATOR, 3.4-fold. The same paper's abstract says single and multiple bepirovirsen doses were assessed 'in 96 healthy volunteers'; its Results say '96 healthy volunteers were SCREENED, among whom 28 were randomly assigned' (16 single-dose, 12 multiple-dose). Any incidence computed from that abstract would be wrong by a factor of 3.4. n_enrolled records 28 randomized and names the 96 as screened.
(3) AN UNSUPPORTED HUMAN NEGATIVE. TMSR1750 enters the dataset as an explicit human grade-0 negative for RTR5001 from Valenzuela 2023 Table 2. Tracing that cell to its reference 37 and reading the trial report (PMC4693495) shows platelets are NEVER mentioned in it; routine haematology appears only in the Methods list of safety assessments and no haematology result is reported. The 'no effect in humans' entry is an inference from a silent source, so platelet_endpoint_evaluable is set to 'partial', not 'yes'. The same trial was positive for renal tubular toxicity (one biopsy-proven acute tubular necrosis, development terminated), so its silence on platelets is not a clean bill of health.
(4) SYNONYM INFLATION IN THE META-ANALYSIS DRUG COUNT. Vermeer 2026 Table 2 reports 'Number of drugs included 49', but Table 1 lists the same compound under two names in at least four cases: aprinocarsen (2 studies) and ISIS 3521 (2 studies) are one drug; G3139 (3 studies) is oblimersen; IONIS-TTRrx and inotersen are one drug; AKCEA-TTR-LRx and eplontersen are one drug; and ISIS-CRPrx/ISIS-CRPRx appear twice on a case difference. The true number of distinct compounds is below 49.
(5) AUTHORSHIP. The lead curator's brief calls PMID 42381708 'Bijl 2026'; the first author is Vermeer C and the corresponding author is Bremer J. There is no Bijl on the paper. The study_key uses vermeer2026.
(6) ENROLLMENT MISMATCHES recorded rather than smoothed: ARC1779 phase 1, 47 (publication) vs 42 (registry, no ACTUAL flag); IONIS-AGT-LRx CS1, 61 (publication arm counts) vs 62 (registry ACTUAL).

WHERE THE PLATELET ENDPOINT IS NOT ACTUALLY EVALUABLE. Three of the 19 units contribute NO platelet evidence at all and are marked platelet_endpoint_evaluable='no' with n_analyzed_platelet=0: the alicaforsen high-dose PK trial (Yacyshyn 2002 - all three of its rows are post-infusion PTT prolongation values; platelets are never mentioned in the source) and the ARC1779 phase 1 healthy-volunteer study (its single row is a zero-bleeding statement; platelet count is never mentioned). A further five units are 'partial' because the source's negative is at haematology-panel level, or programme level, or is second-hand: ISIS104838-phase1-TNFalpha, ISIS757456-CS1, vermeer2026-aso-adverse-event-meta, bepirovirsen-BClear-209668, ISIS546254-CS1 and SPC5001-901-FIH. No negative was manufactured anywhere: absence of a reported platelet event is never recorded as a measured negative.

DENOMINATORS THAT MUST NOT BE SUMMED. n_enrolled and n_analyzed_platelet are kept distinct throughout. Specific traps: the Vermeer 2026 meta-analysis has a DIFFERENT study-count denominator for every MedDRA term it reports (thrombocytopenia 21 studies, platelet analyses 8, coagulation and bleeding 11, haemorrhages NEC 7, intravenous-subgroup thrombocytopenia 16, placebo-controlled risk difference 2) and no patient-level platelet denominator at all; the B-Clear row's 229 is a subset printed by the secondary source that could not be reconciled to the trial's 457 randomized, and no arithmetic was performed on it; the four bepirovirsen device-study bleeding rows are nested INSIDE the 29/159 thrombocytopenia-AESI composite; the ten eplontersen rows are 5 dose cells crossed with 2 thresholds (<100 x10^9/L and <140 x10^9/L LLN); and in the danvatirsen trial the grade >=3 platelet row, the dose-reduction row and the anti-drug-antibody row are almost certainly the same single cohort-2 patient.

ROW-GRAIN TRAPS RETAINED FROM THE INPUT. Zero-dose control rows (TMSR527, TMSR532 eplontersen placebo; TMSR468 ARC1779 disease baseline; TMSR1894 volanesorsen pre-treatment baseline) are exposure-free denominators, not exposed observations. TMSR468 carries grade 3 purely because the band observed pre-dose was 40 x10^9/L in patients enrolled FOR thrombocytopenia - it must never be attributed to ARC1779. TMSR469 shows platelet counts RISING on ARC1779, which is the intended on-target pharmacodynamic effect in type 2B von Willebrand disease, not a toxicity signal. TMSR487 (18% 'thrombocytopenia' AESI) is a composite dominated by injection-site bruising and haemorrhage, not by low platelet counts - only 1 of 159 participants in that study had a low platelet count.

1-vs-2 TRIAL AMBIGUITIES, FLAGGED NOT HIDDEN (each would raise the trial count by one if resolved the other way). (a) ISIS104838-phase1-TNFalpha: the paper is titled 'Phase I trial' (singular) but describes an i.v. dose-escalation trial plus 'additional volunteers' receiving s.c. injections; resolved as one unit on the singular title. (b) fesomersen-ION957943-CS1: patent Examples 4 (single dose) and 5 (multiple dose) are resolved as the SAD and MAD portions of one registered protocol (NCT03582462, 'Single and Multiple Doses... to Healthy Volunteers'); the patent's Example text could not be retrieved (Google Patents returned a 1.1 kB stub to curl; freepatentsonline served only a 'Loading...' placeholder), so this rests on the input rows' transcription plus the registry design match.

CROSS-CLUSTER OVERLAP FLAGS, as requested for the meta-analysis. Table 1 of Vermeer 2026 enumerates all 101 included studies, so its constituents are identifiable in principle (constituents_identifiable='yes'), but only ONE constituent is instantiated as its own record (bepirovirsen-BClear-209668, the single constituent a measurement row in this cluster resolves to); the other 100 are deliberately not created. By compound, the enumerated studies overlap: volanesorsen (3 studies) -> cluster_volanesorsen; inotersen + IONIS-TTRrx (2 studies) -> cluster_inotersen; mipomersen (11) and ISIS 5132 (6) -> most likely cluster_crooke2017_pooled; G3139/oblimersen (3), AZD9150/danvatirsen (1) and ISIS 3521/aprinocarsen (4) -> cluster_oncology_aso; and within THIS cluster: AZD9150 (danvatirsen-D5660C00017), IONIS-AGT-LRx (ISIS757456-CS1/CS2/CS3), ISIS 2302 (alicaforsen-ISIS2302-highdose-PK-crohn), ISIS 3521 (ISIS3521-yuen1999-phase1) and AKCEA-TTR-LRx (eplontersen-ION682884-CS1). The meta-analysis table does not say which registered study each entry is, so trial-level double counting with those records cannot be excluded and is flagged in each record's notes rather than silently resolved. Bepirovirsen is NOT among the original 101 - it enters only through the post hoc set. Separately, ISIS 104838 spans this cluster and cluster_crooke2017_pooled (see unassignable TMSR981), and volanesorsen appears in this cluster only as a 4-patient real-world observational cohort, distinct from every volanesorsen registration trial.

SCOPE CAVEAT ON TWO COMPOUNDS. ARC1779 is an APTAMER, not an antisense oligonucleotide, and its bleeding liability is designed-in blockade of the vWF A1-GPIb axis; its three units are retained with on-target flags so a consumer can exclude them from the ASO class hypothesis. Danvatirsen's thrombocytopenia is on-MECHANISM (STAT3 inhibition, as with JAK inhibitors) but not on-INDICATION - the therapeutic intent is antitumour and platelet loss is unwanted toxicity - so it is retained as in scope with the mechanism recorded for stratification.
